'''Evresh Mandritis''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
If players choose to save Lord [[Cytharat]], they will receive a forwarded medical brief composed by Mandritis about Cytharat's treatment.
